Conjure Quartz Focus

Sorcerer · Level 10 · Conjuration

Effect

Conjures a quartz focus that, when used, increases intelligence, wisdom, and grants see invisibility. Only one Focus may be active at a time.

Notes

Only one Focus may be active at a time.

Previously recorded by The Telon Project as: “Conjures a Quartz focus that, when used, increases intelligence and wisdom, and grants invisibility” (http://thetelonproject.wikidot.com/abilities:conjure-quartz-focus)
